title: fm-protocol.sh: round three and its violations
acceptance: Historical transport/threshold clarification (captain, 2026-10-02): any PR-comment source or delayed closed-list threshold below describes the earlier implementation, not the adopted contract. SK-007 requires the complete standing list with every REJECT from round one; an ask is only for a missing or unclear list before edits. T-135 owns authenticated local brief/ask/verdict/list records, gate-7/protocol readers and delivery to reviewers from round two. Posting is optional projection. Other historical acceptance remains unchanged; this note claims no runtime implementation.
rounds one and two are not policed
round three with no ASK-PASS-CRITERIA from the worker is a violation, exit 3
a reviewer who never posts CRITERIA-COMPLETE leaves the list open, exit 4
after the list closes, a comment must cite an item on it, carry REGRESSION:, or be the APPROVE; anything else is a violation, exit 5
a comment from anyone but the configured reviewer does not trip it
it counts and reports how many items the closed list held
every violation is emitted so the captain sees the reviewer drip-feeding
the suite runs from recorded comment payloads and makes no network call
